definitions.Top_Bottom: Pooled purchase-size quantiles with boundary ties retained; these are not wealth, income, sophistication, or institutional-status classes.
definitions.edge: Amount-weighted coallocation of two subjects through the same October-active wallets.
definitions.critical_guardrail: These are subject networks. A subject rich-club or hub concentration result is not a wallet rich-club and does not identify rich people.

method.matched_networks: All four graphs are embedded in the same 22-subject taxonomy. Similarities use edge vectors normalized to unit total; absolute dollars are reported separately.
method.matched_density: Top-22 and top-40 edge Jaccard values compare identical edge budgets. The main network figure uses the top 40 positive edges in every graph.
method.community: Weighted Louvain at resolutions (0.75, 1.0, 1.25); 200 independent seeds per network and resolution. Coassignment matrices and mean pairwise adjusted Rand index quantify seed stability. No candidate labels enter optimization.
method.hierarchy: Average-linkage clustering of subjects using 1 minus cosine similarity between their rows in the average normalized four-network matrix.
method.rich_club: Top 20% and 30% of subjects ranked by strength. Internal weight share is compared with 4999 fixed-topology permutations of the observed positive edge weights, re-ranking subjects in every replicate; Holm across eight tests.
